Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 103. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You’ve developed the skills necessary to hold your own
in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following
benefits:
You have advantage on attack rolls against a
creature you are grappling.
You can use your action to try to pin a creature
grappled by you. To do so, make another grapple
check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both
restrained until the grapple ends.
